description: List the review decisions settled on a Foundry ontology: the overrides each load after them applies. An approval of a held claim (release), a chosen value (prop) and a resolve also apply to the current load at once (a resolve of a name that load already links another way only from the next load). A reject is a person's word that a held claim is wrong: it is sent to no load, its review stays in the graph and stays counted in left_for_review, and people no longer see it under Needs review or in the review queue. A decision made on a card of the site's review queue says how it was drawn (drawn). A withdraw is an approval a person took back from the current load, which may have written it: that load is sent it at once, and it is listed only while that load is current. applied says what became of each in the current load; of a withdraw, withdrawn means the claim is held for review again, and refused that what the approval wrote stays.

page_token.description: Opaque continuation token from the previous call.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_list_review_decisions

applied.description: What became of a release, a chosen value, a resolve or a withdraw in the ontology's current load; absent for one that load's list doesn't hold yet (a resolve of a name the load already linked another way waits for the next load), and for a reject. A resolve applies to the current load at once: one that chose an entity also links that name to it in every document of that load where the load would otherwise ask (an alias; a document's extraction names says what became of it there), and not in data applies to its own document only.

reason.description: Why it was refused, in the engine's word or the backend's (document_changed: the load holds the claim's document with other text than the claim was read in, so it can't write it; a new load reads the new text and writes it where its commit holds the same claim, and otherwise the claim must be found and approved again in that load's reviews); when unconfirmed, why no word came (job_failed, or of a withdraw not_replayed or document_failed).

status.description: A release: pending, written, refused, missed or unconfirmed (its job failed before saying). A value: pending, applied or unconfirmed. A resolve: pending, written (reason not_asked: nothing in the load asked about the name any more), refused (reason: the engine's word, as an extraction name's reason, or not_named, or no_word: its job ended without word of its document, and the next load applies it) or unconfirmed. A withdraw: pending, withdrawn (the claim is held again), not_written (the load held nothing the approval wrote), refused (what the approval wrote stays) or unconfirmed (no word came: its job failed, and the ontology's next job sends it again; or, with not_replayed, its document's saved reading can't be reused, so no word can come while this load is current and the next load won't write the approval; or, with document_failed, the next approval or take-back in its document sends it again). Empty: the load read it when it was made and no job said what became of it.

takes_back.description: Of a release: the current load may have written it, so removing the decision takes it back from that load rather than only dropping it.

drawn.description: ranked or random: how the review queue showed the card it was decided on; absent for a decision made elsewhere

title: List review decisions
